method: Bounded diffuse pigment inferred from measured scene-linear black/0.1-gray responses, with multiscale highlight filling and depth/facing visibility. Hidden wood uses a continuous object-space sample of the existing unlit walnut source.
assumptions: Local de-lighting and hidden grain are artistic estimates. The PNG stores pigment, rendered through a real Principled BSDF and real lamps.

source_measurement.method: Scene-linear black and neutral 0.1 BSDF passes preserve actual reflections, geometry and lights. The separate depth pass measures visibility for UV projection. Diagnostics never enter the public beauty images.
